newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria Finmin to submit budget to cabinet July 24.
newsitem.headline: Austria Finmin to submit budget to cabinet July 24.

text.p: Austrian Finance Minister Rudolf Edlinger said on Tuesday he would submit his draft 1998 budget for ministerial approval at the next cabinet meeting on Thursday, July 24.
Edlinger, speaking after this week's cabinet meeting, said he was confident of winning support for the budget although "a few points" remained open.
"We will achieve the Maastricht goal and our 1998 budget deficit target of 2.6 percent (of GDP)," he said, referring to central government's deficit.
Edlinger, a member of Chancellor Viktor Klima's Social Democrats, is scheduled to deliver his budget speech to parliament in September. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
